text:
Ashley: quick check — I'm pushing a TF change to add a dedicated NAT GW + route table for the new service subnet (svc-east). Also adding a route propagation to the shared egress TGW and a PrivateLink endpoint in the infra account. PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/infra/pulls/742

Sam: can you paste the plan output? worried about replacing existing route tables on svc-east

Ashley: plan snippet:
```
# aws_route_table_association.svc_east[0] will be created
+ resource "aws_route_table_association" "svc_east" {
+   subnet_id = "subnet-0a1b2c3d"
+   route_table_id = "rtb-0f1e2d3c"
+ }
# aws_route.svc_east_tgw_route will be created
+ resource "aws_route" "svc_east_tgw_route" {
+   destination_cidr_block = "0.0.0.0/0"
+   transit_gateway_id = "tgw-0abc1234"
+   route_table_id = "rtb-0f1e2d3c"
+ }
```

Kai: note — if you create a new rtb and assoc, make sure the subnet tagging doesn't trigger autoscaler rules; also double-check NAT health checks.

Ashley: tests passed in my sandbox, but kube egress tests failed once due to missing SNAT on pods.

Sam: are you changing source/destination checks or using iptables SNAT in node? we need to keep node e2e behavior identical

Ashley: using managed NAT GW + force_nat = true in our module (same as other svc). SNAT should be automatic.

infra-bot: plan result for pr/742 — 2 to add, 0 to change, 0 to destroy. CI: tf-lint OK. (run id: ci-8872)

Sneh: small ask — can you separate the PrivateLink endpoint into its own apply? last time shared services had a hiccup when both were rolled together.

Ashley: yeah can split. I can open a follow-up PR for module:privatelink and keep this strictly nat/rt assoc.

Kai: +1 to split. also add `depends_on = [aws_ec2_transit_gateway_vpc_attachment.shared]` to the tgw route resource so we don't race.

Ashley: good call. adding that.

Sam: one more — run `terraform import aws_route_table_association.svc_east subnet-0a1b2c3d/rtb-0f1e2d3c` in staging before apply? otherwise apply will try to create and fail due to existing association

Ashley: hmm association doesn't exist yet in staging. import needed only if we are reusing rtb. I'll check staging.

infra-bot: deploy job queued for infra/staging (job 992) :hourglass_flowing_sand: 

Ashley: ok going to split PRs and update plan. will ping when ready. thanks all :thumbsup: 

Sam: lgtm once split and depends_on added

Kai: ping me for rollout window — prefer early morning for no user traffic

Ashley: noted, will schedule 02:00 UTC window and post in #eng-oncall
